{{Quote|Now I know what's with those rogue droids! That crazy HK AI had those things trying to help him get his body back and now they're trying to help him get off the planet!|A spacer|<ref name="EM">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Exploring%20Mustafar&resource=features|text=Exploring Mustafar}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' took place in a volcano crater on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] between a group of spacers working for [[Mensix Corp]] and the remnants of [[HK-47]]'s [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Although HK-47 himself survived the battle, the complete destruction of his droid army definitively halted his droid revolution on Mustafar.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The droid army is gone, but did you stop the problem at its source?''"<br />"''The droid factory is offline, but HK-47 was nowhere to be seen.''"<br />"''That would explain the strange signals we have been monitoring from the volcano crater. We managed to decipher the signal, and it sounds like someone is trying to flag down a passing ship. It must be HK-47.|[[Milo Mensix]] and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />}}
Some time during the Old Republic era, a [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] crashed on the planet Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:TDS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Downed Ship|Mustafar}}</ref> One of the cruiser's passengers was [[HK-47]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] that served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> Centuries later, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] discovered the wreck of the cruiser.<ref name="SWG:ORC">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=loading|Old Republic Cruiser|Mustafar}}</ref> They excavated the wreckage<ref name="SWG:JK">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=conversation|Jo Keslev|Mustafar}}</ref> and discovered HK-47. When the Separatist [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] realized that the droid's technology was superior than anything they knew, they reactivated HK-47. However, the droid was too dangerous and the Neimoidian engineers were forced to transfer his memory and thought patterns into a sub-system of the crashed cruiser. [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] later ordered the construction of a [[Neimoidian droid factory|droid factory]] on Mustafar in order to produce an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] based on HK-47's technology. Unfortunately for the Separatists, the construction of the droid factory was only achieved in the last days of the Clone Wars and the new battle droid models were never deployed. In the meantime, HK-47 remained conscious but stuck in the ruined system of the wrecked Old Republic cruiser.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />

[[File:HK47_army_in_volcano.jpg|thumb|left|280px|[[HK-47]] and his [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]].]]
Two decades later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of spacers working for [[Mensix Corp]] explored the wreckage of the Old Republic cruiser when they discovered the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] of a droid trapped in a computer.<ref name="SWG:TTotA">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Transfer of the AI|Mustafar}}</ref> HK-47 tricked the spacers into helping him to escape the ship's computer. The spacers accepted and followed HK-47's instructions to transfer his AI to the old Separatist droid factory.<ref name="SWG:WPWT">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Wrong Place, Wrong Time|Mustafar}}</ref> However, they soon realized that they inadvertently allowed HK-47 to reactivate the factory and take control of a large [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]]. Furious at having been stuck in a wreck for so long, the assassin droid wanted to take revenge by destroying all [[Species/Legends|organics]] on the planet. The droid ordered his army to march toward the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining facility]], the largest facility of the continent, but the droids were stopped at the [[Koseyet Mining Camp]]. After HK-47's droid army was destroyed at the [[Battle of Koseyet]], the spacers raided the droid factory and successfully disabled the facility.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Your persistence is most entertaining meatbag. Request: Can I call you my friend? don't let the attempts to kill you confuse that point as I try to kill all organics, but I do not believe any of the organics I have known are still around in this time. I will think of you and tell someone they remind me of my friend before I blast them, it will be great fun.|[[HK-47]]|<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />}}
[[File:Battle_in_a_volcano_crater_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Force adept fighting the AK-Prime.]]
After loosing his army and his droid factory, HK-47 gathered his last forces in a volcano crater and broadcasted a distress signal in order to flag down a passing ship and escape the planet. The head of [[Mensix Corp]], [[Milo Mensix]], considered that HK-47 was too dangerous to be allowed to leave Mustafar and tasked the spacers to destroy the droid once for all. Mensix then hired the pilot [[Menddle]], the only pilot in the area who was crazy enough to drop the spacers in the volcano crater.<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />

[[File:Battle_in_a_volcano_crater_3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A Force adept fighting the CY-M Prototype.]]
After arriving in the crater, the spacers realized that HK-47 had managed to contact a [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] and was about to escape the planet. The adventurers headed to the landing area by progressing through a narrow band of land surrounded by lava. On their way, they had to fight five waves of droids send against them by HK-47. The first wave was made of the [[HK-Taskmaster]] and its [[SK-21 support droid]]s, the second encompassed [[AK-Prime]] and [[HK-77 assassin droid|HK-77 assault droids]], the third included the [[Forward Commander Mk II]] and HK-77 assault droids, the fourth was made of the [[CY-M Prototype]] and [[Kubaza beetle/Legends|Kubaza beetles]], the fifth was made of the [[GK Oppressor]], [[Union Sentry Droid|GK-14 Defenders]] and [[Union Sentry Droid|GK-18 Sentinels]]. The spacers heroically destroyed the five waves of droids, continuing their progression in the volcano.<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />

The adventurers eventually arrived at the freighter where they were attacked by HK-47 himself, along with his escort of SK-21 support droids, GK-14 Defenders and [[AK-3 "Reaper"]] droids. The spacers fought the droids and finally demolished all of them. HK-47 was also apparently destroyed in the battle.<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I must admit that you almost make me wish I still needed a good master...almost. Your little grey brain must be getting confused at this point...I understand that happens a lot with your kind. I didn't survive for four thousand years in the husk of a ship just to be destroyed by a few lucky shots.|HK-47|<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />}}
The destruction of HK-47's army definitively removed the threat of the vindictive droids to Milo Mensix and his miners. However, contrary to appearances, HK-47 was not destroyed in the battle in the battle in a volcano crater. Despite his damages, the old assassin droid survived the clash and successfully escaped the planet Mustafar. Impressed by the abilities of the spacers who defeated him, HK-47 later sent a threatening message to them, revealing his survival and exposing his intentions: retaliate against the Neimoidians and some other enemies in the galaxy; and eventually take his revenge on the spacers.<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in a volcano crater appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DHK47" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The battle was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]]. It was the final battle of the "[[W:c:swg:Champion of Mustafar|Champion of Mustafar]]" quest line.<ref name="SWG:DHK47" />
